Name: Seasonal Signposts (with optional nighttime glow)
Author: novust
Description:
[size=4][b][img]https://i.ibb.co/4nSpk6hp/description.png[/img][/b][/size]

[i]Seasonal Signposts[/i] adds craftable signposts that function like text signs and automatically change with the seasons.

They also match the ones around town!

There are two types: one that emits light at night, and one that doesn't.


[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/FqNzB6cX/requirements-installation.png[/img][/b]

• The most recent versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53263]Custom Text Signs[/url]
• Download and unzip into your Mods folder


[img]https://i.ibb.co/Y7FWbmvc/in-game-requirements.png[/img]

None! The crafting recipes are available from the beginning.
• The non-glowing version requires 20 wood.
• The glowing version requires 20 wood and a torch. (There is no need to turn them on and off; they do it automatically based on the time of day, just like lamps.)


[color=#D4D4D8][img]https://i.ibb.co/Hpk9sGcQ/compatibility.png[/img][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
• No foreseeable conflicts, due to the mod's simplicity.[/color]
• Not tested in multiplayer, but should be fine.
• If you are an Android user, please [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53255?tab=posts][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53255?tab=posts]let me know[/url] if [i]Seasonal Signposts[/i] works for you!
[color=#D4D4D8]• If you use Left Shift for any other mods, you will want to re-key/disable it through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url].[/color]


[color=#D4D4D8][b][img]https://i.ibb.co/GvhKCwBB/mod-recommendations.png[/img][/b][/color]

I highly recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] if you need to configure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53263]Custom Text Signs[/url]. (This is not necessary if you don't want to change how any signs behave or use Left Shift for anything in another mod. Seasonal Signposts does not have a config file.)
